title: Effects
description: What an actor may change: three lists of path patterns, relative to the theatre's root (the run's workspace). With nothing declared, an actor is read-only. Declaring effects isn't enforcement: only a stage that enforces effects contains a run.

pattern.title: Effect pattern
pattern.description: A path pattern relative to the theatre's root, with / between its parts: * matches within one part, ** as a whole part matches any number of parts, ? matches one character, and anything else matches itself. Never absolute, never with .., \, :, a control character, an empty part or ** inside a part, and never starting with .git or .troupe, which no effect can allow changing.

effects.title: Declared effects
effects.description: The effects an actor declares in config. Each list is optional, and absent declares nothing.

write.title: Write
write.description: Where a run may create or change files (Write and Edit).

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Where a run may remove files. Declared apart from write, because it's more destructive.

move.title: Move
move.description: Where a run may move or rename files: both the source and the destination must match.

declaration.title: Declared effects, explicit
declaration.description: The effects troupe sends a runner: all three lists, each present, so a read-only actor is three empty lists and a runner never has to guess.
